name: Chaeremon
bio: Chaeremon is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors gives no date for the poet. Paton's index lists the poet among the writers of Meleager's Wreath, the Garland compiled about 100 BC.
This archive carries the 3 epigrams ascribed to the poet in the second volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book VII: 469, 720, 721).

poems.title: Book VII, 469
poems.author: Chaeremon
poems.text: Athenagores begot Eubulus, excelled by all in fate, excelling all in good report.

poems.title: Book VII, 720
poems.author: Chaeremon
poems.text: Cleinas, the son of Etymocles, who didst wield the spear for Thyreae, thou didst die allotting to thyself the disputed land.

poems.title: Book VII, 721
poems.author: Chaeremon
poems.text: We from Sparta eng: aged the Argives equal in number and in arms, Thyreae being the prize of the spear, and both abandoning without seeking for pretexts our hope of return home, we leave the birds to tell of our death.
